threads.body: [Javaagent] Mark this additive ContextView Muzzle pass as documentation-only ignored. The instrumentation docs parser emits every unignored pass as a supported target range, so this currently generates both `[3.1.0.RELEASE,)` and the redundant `[3.4.0,)` under the consolidated `reactor-3.1` entry, misleading readers into thinking they are separate support ranges. This follows the additive-pass convention documented in `instrumentation-docs/readme.md:353-379` and used by Couchbase/Jedis.

threads.body: [Testing] Keep an always-wired integration suite for the ContextView bridge's 3.4.0 lower bound. This suite is disabled in ordinary `check` runs and, when `testLatestDeps` is enabled, runs only against `latest.release`; the default suite uses Reactor 3.1 and cannot load `ContextView`. As a result, consolidating the module removes the installed-agent coverage that the former Reactor 3.4 project ran at its minimum supported version. A dedicated 3.4.0 `JvmTestSuite` (optionally alongside this latest-dependency suite) would preserve that compatibility coverage.
